title: National Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan

definition.text: A country's main plan for carrying out the Biodiversity Convention at home, known as an NBSAP.

facts.text: The Convention requires each country to prepare a national biodiversity strategy and build it into planning in every sector that affects biodiversity.
As of early 2012, 173 Parties had developed NBSAPs.
Countries were expected to present updated NBSAPs to meet the Kunming-Montreal targets before COP16, but only 25 of 195 had done so.
Only five of the 17 megadiverse countries and four G7 nations submitted theirs by the deadline.
Japan's 2023 NBSAP includes the aim of a nature-positive economy.
